transcript.text: Good morning. Before we get into the schedule, I need to flag two items from the motor-pool inspection log that haven't gone to operations yet. Also, the South Yard access lane is reserved for the barrier movement from 1000 through 1200. I'll formally disclose both of these now so they're on the record for the meeting.
